explanation: The particle will describe a helical path with axis along +z direction if (i) component of net force in x-y plane provides the centripetal acceleration and (ii) the particle has a non-zero velocity and/or non-zero force along +z direction. A proton with initial velocity will move in a helical path with axis along +z direction when placed in an electric field and magnetic field .
